svg.title: Switch Pro controller diagram
svg.desc: Flat drawing of a Switch Pro controller. Interactive shapes use ControllerInput ids: A (right), B (bottom), X (top), Y (left), View (minus), Menu (plus), the D-pad arms, the shoulder arcs (LeftBumper, RightBumper; digital), the trigger bands behind them (LeftTrigger, RightTrigger; digital) and the two thumbstick groups (the stick and cap rings move together; the cap is L3/R3). Glyph strokes carry data-for with the input they mark. Home and Capture are decorative.
